title: Activate and verify DappGo website security headers at Cloudflare edge
question: Can the website security-header contract be activated at the actual edge and recorded without claiming a host-only change is live?
hypotheses: A host-scoped Cloudflare response-header rule can activate the existing contract without changing application routes or subdomain behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Cloudflare edge returns the four required response headers for dappgo.com.
Cloudflare edge returns the conditional HSTS header after HTTPS readiness was verified.
The repository contract and handoff document accurately record live edge activation.
Website quality checks pass and no public routes or app links regress.
evidence: Owner requested completion of the remaining website improvement items; Cloudflare edge configuration is scoped to dappgo.com and www.dappgo.com.
